purpose: Generate controlled synthetic or authorized contrasts that vary one or a small number of craft decisions while holding passage state constant, and record technique/effect evidence without named-author imitation.
core_rules: Every contrast binds one immutable reference passage-state id.
A qualified pair changes one primary craft variable or an explicitly bounded interacting set.
Uncontrolled semantic, canon, POV, character-knowledge, protected-language, or voice changes invalidate the pair as positive evidence.
Hard negatives preserve failure evidence and must not be silently discarded.
Technique effects are conditioned hypotheses, not universal quality claims.
Synthetic contrasts may use invented text only; user manuscript text is not required for STEP-G qualification.
Named-author targeting, nearest-author objectives, and prestige imitation are prohibited.
A transform specifies an operation and preservation obligations; it is not authority to apply that operation to a manuscript.
Ambiguous or multi-variable contrasts remain diagnostic-only unless separately decomposed.
Pair identity and provenance are deterministic.
